class ChandrasekharSieveTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chandrasekharsieve(self):
        cs = ChandrasekharSieve(20)
        res = cs.generate_primes()
        self.assertEqual(res, [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19])
        res = cs.get_primes()
        self.assertEqual(res, [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19])
